title: Sr. Manager, Material Development
descriptionText:
Job Description     
Fabletics is looking for a  Sr. Manager, Material Development.      
How do you fit in?   
As Sr. Manager, Material Development, you will be the creative and technical authority for materials at Fabletics, shaping the aesthetic vision and development strategy for fabrics across the brand. You will lead material development from concept through commercialization. This is a high-impact leadership where impeccable taste meets technical mastery.    
You will manage and develop the Sr. R&D Associates, partner closely with Design, and set the standard for what exceptional materials look, feel, and perform like at Fabletics. This role requires deep material expertise, a high taste level, and the strategic mindset to scale ideas into product.    
The  Sr. Manager, Material Development  will report to the  Sr. Director, Fabric Development, Innovation & Sourcing.      
What you will do:    
Material Development & Strategy     
Own the end-to-end material development roadmap, from seasonal concept ideation through bulk production approval.    
Define and elevate the Fabletics materials aesthetic - establishing a high taste level and clear point of view across knits, wovens, and performance fabrics.    
Lead direct mill and vendor partnerships globally, optimizing cost and quality; negotiate pricing and lead times with mills and suppliers. Ensure all quality meets our standards.    
Translate design intent into manufacturable, performance-driven, and commercially viable material solutions; embed material milestones into the product calendar.    
Experience in leggings or bodywear categories is a strong plus.       
Innovation & Trend     
Identify global material trends, emerging technologies, and consumer insights, linking them to clear business and aesthetic opportunities.    
Drive material innovation across constructions, finishes, fibers, and sustainability.    
Stay current on competitive landscape, industry developments, and mill capabilities.       
Cross-Functional Partnership     
Build and sustain strong functional relationships with the Design team — operating as a trusted creative partner who elevates the product vision through materials expertise.    
Collaborate closely with Production, Merchandising, Product Development, and Sourcing to ensure materials meet aesthetic, performance, cost, and delivery targets.    
Communicate complex material findings, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.    
Champion a culture of curiosity, speed, and continuous improvement.       
Team Leadership & People Development     
Directly manage and develop the fabric team — coaching performance, building capability, and fostering a high-standards environment.    
Build scalable workflows and SOPs that elevate quality, accountability, and speed across the material development function.    
Operate as a senior leader within the Fabric, Color, & Trims department — contributing to team strategy, departmental goals, and broader cross-functional initiatives.       
Project & Process Management     
Prioritize a high volume of material projects across concurrent seasons and categories.    
Maintain dashboards and reports to track development progress, cost savings, supplier performance, and approvals.    
Establish and publish KPIs tied to material readiness, first-pass approval rates, cost targets, and supplier OTIF.    
Own material data in PLM/BOM systems; ensure accuracy, version control, and visibility.    
Demonstrate systems and data fluency, including Smartsheet and PLM platforms; comfort with AI tools is highly valued.       
What you bring:     
7+ years of fabric development experience, including end-to-end material programs across lifestyle and performance fabrics. Ready-to-wear or fashion brand experience is a plus.    
3+ years managing a team within material development, R&D, fabric, or material design functions — with a track record of developing talent and building high-performing teams.    
Deep technical expertise across knit and or woven constructions, yarns, fibers, dyes, finishes, and printing techniques — with a strong ability to problem solve material quality issues as they arise.    
High taste level and passion for materials and design, with the ability to define and communicate what makes a material exceptional.    
Proven partnership with Design, balancing creative intent with technical feasibility.    
Direct experience with global fabric mills including managing costs, lead times, and development timeline management.    
Strong color acuity and attention to aesthetic detail.    
Experience in managing consistent quality for leggings and bodywear is a plus.    
Builder mindset: comfortable creating new processes and SOPs, and scaling new ways of working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.    
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to mills, factories, and trade shows.    
Bachelor's degree in Textile Design, Materials Science, Apparel Design, or a related field preferred.    
Ideal candidate brings foundational AI literacy, including experience using generative AI tools, and a proactive mindset to experiment with new technologies to drive productivity and innovation.

title: Associate Director, Data Enablement
descriptionText:
Who We Are  
 
VML, part of WPP, is a leading creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce, creating connected brands to drive growth. VML is celebrated for its innovative and human first, award-winning work for blue chip client partners including AstraZeneca, Colgate-Palmolive, Dell, Ford, Microsoft, Nestlé, The Coca-Cola Company, and Wendy's. The agency is recognized by the Forrester Wave™ Reports, as a Leader among Marketing Creative and Content Service Providers, Commerce Services, Global Digital Experience Services, Global Marketing Services and, most recently, Marketing Measurement & Optimization. In addition, VML's specialist health network, VML Health, is one of the world's largest and most awarded health agencies. VML's global network is powered by 26,000 talented people across 55+ markets, with principal offices in Kansas City, New York, Detroit, London, São Paulo, Shanghai, Singapore, and Sydney. 
  
About WPP  
 
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.    
The Opportunity:  We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented  Analytics Technical Specialist  to join our Data Enablement Team. You will be instrumental in the technical implementation, management, and quality assurance of cutting-edge analytics platforms, with a strong focus on Tealium as well as the Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) and Customer Journey Analytics (CJA). This role requires deep expertise in tag management, data layer design, pixel tracking, server-side implementations and Web/Mobile SDKs, alongside rigorous analytics QA to ensure robust and accurate data collection that informs our customer engagement and marketing strategies. 
  
Responsibilities:  
 
  Tagging, Tag Management & Data Layer Design:  
   Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive data collection strategies within Adobe Experience Platform. 
   Manage and administer our Tealium and Adobe Experience Platform Tags (formerly Launch) instances, including the configuration of tags, triggers, and variables for various analytics, marketing, and advertising platforms. 
   Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable data layer specifications across all digital properties (web, mobile apps) to ensure consistent and accurate data capture. 
   Provide guidance and support to development teams on proper client-side and server-side (Event Forwarding) implementation and API integrations. 
    Analytics Quality Assurance (QA):  
   Develop and execute comprehensive analytics QA processes and test plans to validate data layer integrity, tag firing, and data accuracy within AEP and other analytics systems. 
   Perform rigorous testing using debugger tools, network inspectors, and platform interfaces to identify, diagnose, and troubleshoot data collection issues. 
   Collaborate closely with development, product, and QA teams to ensure timely resolution of identified data discrepancies. 
   Document QA findings, test cases, and best practices. 
    Collaboration & Communication:  
   Serve as a subject matter expert on analytics implementation, providing technical guidance and training to internal stakeholders. 
   Work cross-functionally with product managers, developers, marketing teams, and other data teams to ensure seamless integration and utilization of analytics data. 
   Contribute to the continuous improvement of our data governance, documentation, and analytics infrastructure. 
 
  Requirements:  
 
 3-5+ years of hands-on experience in digital analytics implementation, technical tag management, and data quality assurance. 
   Proficiency with Tealium (iQ / EventStream) and/or Adobe Experience Platform Tags (formerly Launch). 
   Proven experience implementing and validating data for Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Analytics. 
   Proven experience designing, implementing, and validating robust server-side tracking and API-based data ingestion. 
   Demonstrated experience in analytics Quality Assurance (QA) methodologies, test plan creation, and using debugging tools (e.g., browser developer tools, Charles proxy, Omnibug). 
   Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS for web analytics implementation, debugging, and custom scripting. 
   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a meticulous attention to detail. 
   Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences. 
 
  About the Data Enablement Team within ME&I:  The Data Enablement Team is a critical function within our Marketing, Engagement & Insights (ME&I) department. We are the architects of our data foundation, responsible for ensuring the accuracy, accessibility, and utility of our marketing and customer data across all digital touchpoints. We empower data-driven decision-making by providing robust, reliable, and scalable analytics solutions. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between business needs and the technical implementation of our analytics infrastructure.   
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. 
 
WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers. 
 
VML is a WPP agency (NYSE: WPP). For more information, please visit www.vml.com, and follow along on Instagram, LinkedIn, and X.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Design
descriptionText:
The Senior Manager of Technical Design will lead a team of technical designers to execute premium medical apparel from concept through pre-production stage. Technical Design is responsible for developing garment fit, construction, grading, and communication with the vendor base. This role will support the cross functional teams through implementation and maintenance of brand standards for fit, construction, and development. Our Ideal candidate is a strong cross functional collaborator who embraces a growth mindset, champions technology, and leads by example, This role reports into the Senior Director of Technical Design. 
 
What You'll Do: 
 
 Establish fit and quality standards for measurement specs, grading, construction details, and on-body standards. 
 Partner with cross functional teams to establish design and fit intent, execute new fit blocks, and drive innovation development. 
 Lead, develop, and mentor a team of technical designers. 
 Build and maintain tech pack data integrity including bill of materials, specs, construction, sketches, etc in Centric PLM to communicate requirements for design aesthetic, fit, and construction to vendor partners. 
 Prioritize and execute daily workload in alignment with GTM deliverables & development timelines. 
 Monitor workflow of all vendors and internal team members to meet GTM calendar deadlines. 
 Lead fit sessions to align on style direction, maintain fit consistency, and establish new silhouettes. 
 Analyze and communicate the outcome of review and fit sessions, artwork reviews, and construction reviews with internal cross functional and external vendor partners. 
 Build and maintain relationships with domestic and international vendor partners through daily communication management. 
 Finalize buy ready tech packs for each season including sketches, artwork, BOMs, final patterns, and size charts. 
 Support the team in style changes, challenges, and solutions at GTM meetings. 
 Manage tracking and approval of prototype samples, strike offs, and testing submits. 
 Develop and maintain tools to deliver consistent fit and high quality construction across product categories aligning to brand standards. 
 Manage seasonal testing processes including wear testing and garment testing. 
 Collaborate with team leaders on cross functional projects to streamline seasonal development. 
 Build and maintain technical design data libraries in Centric PLM. 
 Partner with Product Integrity to creatively solve and prevent quality concerns. 
 
 Qualifications: 
 
 10+ Years working as a proven leader within technical design 
 Associates or bachelor's degree within Fashion Design or Technical Design 
 Prior experience leading and mentoring teams 
 Exceptional knowledge of garment construction, balance and fit, patternmaking, and technical drawing 
 Excellent eye for fit, construction, and detail 
 Excellent communication skills - interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation 
 Requires strong organization, time management, and follow up skills 
 Experience and passion in 2D and 3D patternmaking software - Gerber PDS/Optitex and Clo/Browzwear 
 Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, Excel, and Google Suite 
 Experience with PLM (Centric preferred) 
 Proven work ethic, positive attitude, and integrity 
 Self-motivated, strong sense of urgency, collaborative mindset 
 Travel experience and able to travel 2X a year

 Equity: All FIGS employees have the opportunity to own shares of FIGS stock through our new-hire equity program. Additionally, FIGS provides a discount when purchasing FIGS stock voluntarily through our FIGS Employee Stock Purchase Plan
   Annual bonus: This position is eligible to participate in the FIGS annual bonus program

  Amazing 401(k) program, with a company match up to the first 6% of your contribution

A little bit about us…  
 
FIGS, Inc. is a founder-led, direct-to-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand that seeks to celebrate, empower and serve current and future generations of healthcare professionals. We redefine what scrubs are by creating technically advanced apparel and products that feature an unmatched combination of comfort, durability, function and style, all at an affordable price. Through these customer relationships, FIGS has built a community and lifestyle around a profession, revolutionizing the large and fragmented healthcare apparel market and becoming the industry's category-defining healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand.

title: Associate Creative Director, Motion & Design
descriptionText:
Highwire's creative team sits within the agency's Innovation practice. We lead the creative strategy, design, and execution of powerful, valuable, and impactful ideas that drive business impact for our clients. 
 
We weave insights into ideas, make ideas real, and combine multidimensional creativity with strategic storytelling so our clients stand out from the competition. We believe the biggest ideas don't have to be the most complex, and we champion the importance of matching high-caliber creative delivery with strategic motivation. 
 
As the  Associate Creative Director, Motion & Design , you will be a driving creative force within the agency, working on Fortune 500 clients. You will bridge the gap between high-level conceptual thinking and flawless visual execution, specifically spearheading our motion graphics, video, and digital design output. 
 
In this role, you will lead the creative development of multi-channel campaigns, brand visual identities, and immersive digital experiences for a diverse roster of clients. You aren't just managing the work; you are setting the visual standard, leading pitches, and inspiring a talented team of designers and animators to push boundaries across social media, digital content, events, and interactive platforms. 
 
You'll work seamlessly with our Creative Directors, Digital Strategy Leads, Project Managers, and Account teams to transform complex tech and B2B narratives into awe-inspiring visual stories. This position will report to the VP, Creative Director. 
 
You'll co-lead creative for large-scale account engagements with high visibility and stakes. You'll join at the ground floor of our AI-integrated production workflows, working directly within a guardrail architecture team. You'll step into high-growth engagements, building a record of expanding scope and responsibility. 
  
About you:  
 
You are someone who is equal parts visionary storyteller and hands-on artisan. You know how to command a room, translate client goals into stunning motion and design systems, and elevate the skills of the creatives around you. 
 
  Creative Vision & Motion Mastery:  Your portfolio is a masterclass in modern digital design and dynamic motion graphics. You have a deep understanding of pacing, rhythm, and visual storytelling. You know how to break brand boundaries while respecting core parameters. 
  Leadership & Mentorship:  You are an empathetic, inspiring leader. You know how to give constructive, actionable creative feedback that elevates the work without crushing the creator's spirit. You have direct management experience, including delivering structured performance feedback and development conversations. You can point to specific examples of how you grew a team member's skill set or addressed underperformance directly. 
  Strategic Communication:  You are an exceptional presenter and storyteller. You can confidently sell bold creative concepts to C-suite clients and translate abstract strategic goals into concrete visual directions. You have a track record of defending creative direction in the face of pushback rather than simply executing a brief handed to you. 
  Operational Excellence:  You have owned delivery timelines across multiple concurrent workstreams, with a demonstrated ability to forecast capacity needs, flag bottlenecks before they hit deadlines, and escalate appropriately when scope or resourcing is at risk. 
 
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Creative Assessment & Execution:  Lead the conceptualization and execution of high-impact design and motion concepts for web, social campaigns, event experiences, brand video, and digital products. 
  Motion Pipeline Ownership:  Establish and optimize the agency's motion design standards and best practices, including building scalable motion asset systems (templates, modular components, reusable frameworks) that support high-volume output without sacrificing brand consistency or craft quality. Own and continuously refine motion design workflows end to end (from storyboarding to final post-production), including capacity forecasting, escalation protocols, and bottleneck prediction across simultaneous high-volume workstreams. 
  AI-Integrated Production:  Operate within AI-supported creative production workflows, partnering with technical and AI-focused team members under established human-in-the-loop guardrails to balance speed, scale, and creative quality. 
  Client & Pitch Leadership:  Own creative presentations for major client accounts and high-stakes new business pitches. Effectively articulate the strategic "why" behind creative and motion-driven choices to non-creative stakeholders. 
  Account-Creative Alignment:  Manage friction points between creative timelines and account or client demands, protecting production quality and team capacity while maintaining a collaborative cross-functional relationship. 
  Team Management & Mentorship:  Directly manage a team of motion designers and brand designers, including formal performance reviews and development planning. Foster a culture of continuous learning, creative experimentation, and technical growth, while holding the team to clear delivery and craft standards. 
  Brand Guardianship:  Act as the primary guardian of Highwire's own visual brand, while simultaneously ensuring clients' visual systems remain cohesive and forward-thinking across all mediums. 
  Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Partner with Digital Strategy and Copy leads to ensure copy and visuals work in perfect harmony to drive measurable business results. 
 
  Candidate requirements  
 
  Experience:  8+ years of professional design and motion experience, with at least 3+ years in a dedicated creative leadership or player-coach role (agency experience heavily preferred). Demonstrated direct people management experience, including conducting formal performance evaluations, is required. 
  Portfolio:  A portfolio demonstrating ownership of brand, motion, and video storytelling at a campaign or systems level, not just individual pieces, alongside strong typography, layout, and UI/UX fundamentals. 
  Technical Mastery:  Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma. Experience with 3D software (Cinema 4D or Blender) is a massive plus. Experience with Final Cut Pro and DaVinci Resolve is helpful. 
  Design Systems:  Deep experience creating, scaling, and maintaining comprehensive digital and motion design systems. 
 Strategic Intuition: Strong understanding of UX/UI principles, digital accessibility standards, and multi-platform social media optimization. 
  Culture Fit:  A thriving-under-pressure mentality with strong judgment for managing competing priorities across multiple concurrent projects. Working knowledge of AI-integrated creative workflows, including comfort operating within human-in-the-loop guardrails for AI-supported concepting and production.

title: Associate Director, Brand & Experience Strategy
descriptionText:
Noodle is higher education’s leading strategy, services, and technology partner. We develop infrastructure, provide life-changing learning experiences, and grow the awareness of and the enrollment in some of the best academic institutions in the world. Our vision is “to empower universities to change the world.” We achieve this vision by offering our university partners various products and services that help them be more resilient, responsive, efficient, and interconnected.      
About the Role:   
 
The Associate Director of Brand and Experience Strategy shapes how Noodle's university partners engage prospective students across the full recruitment lifecycle. This role works across brand and messaging strategy, lifecycle communications, content strategy, and student experience design, pairing deep partner knowledge and cross-functional fluency. 
 
As a strategist, you'll act as a consultative partner to both our university partners and internal teams, developing breadth across practice areas while building deeper t-shaped expertise in one or more over time. You'll contribute to frameworks, execute against them with a high degree of independence, and bring strategic thinking to partner-facing work without always being the most senior voice in the room. 
 
The Associate Director plays a supporting role in discovery for their partners, contributing to partner onboarding, program launches, and portfolio expansions. They also act as a consistent second voice in partner relationships, bringing strategic grounding and cross-portfolio insight to partner engagements. 
  
As Associate Director of Brand & Experience Strategy, you will:    
Strategic Practice & Framework Contribution  
  Contribute to one or more strategic practice areas (such as event strategy, lifecycle communications, content strategy framework, messaging architecture, or UX/student experience design), supporting the development and maintenance of frameworks and participating in continuous improvement efforts 
 Execute against shared strategic frameworks and contribute to their documentation and evolution, with the expectation of taking on deeper ownership of a practice area over time 
 Partner with other teams and SMEs to understand the possibilities and limitations as you contribute to and apply shared frameworks 
 Maintain awareness of cross-portfolio patterns, what is working, what is drifting, and why, and surface observations to senior strategists and the broader team 
 Stay current on market trends, student behavior, and higher education recruitment best practices in collaboration with research and analytics teams, bringing relevant insights into partner work 
   Partner Engagement & Discovery  
  Develop familiarity with an assigned set of university partners and their corresponding programs, competitive landscape, institutional priorities, and student audiences 
 Serve as a consistent second voice in partner relationships, bringing practice expertise and cross-portfolio perspective to complement the Integrated Marketing Director's ownership of the partner relationship 
 Participate in discovery engagements for new program launches and portfolio expansions, contributing through a strategic practice lens and supporting the transfer of insights to execution teams 
 Contribute to strategy sessions and workshops with university partner stakeholders, supporting facilitation and helping to surface needs, build alignment, and document actionable plans 
 Develop and deliver presentations that articulate strategy, recommend tactics, and support the positioning of Noodle's services to internal and external stakeholders 
   Lifecycle Communications & Student Experience Design  
  Lead the design and mapping of cross-channel lifecycle communications, including automated email and text journeys, recruitment team communication cadences, chat scripts, and toolkits, ensuring strategic coherence across all touchpoints 
 Oversee journey mapping processes to capture internal stakeholder perspectives and student expectations across the recruitment and retention lifecycle 
 Translate journey insights and partner priorities into clear, actionable briefs that set the implementation team up for successful execution, maintaining a clean handoff between strategy and build 
 Contribute to brand strategy, messaging frameworks, and student experience design as a cross-trained practitioner, with depth in your owned area and working fluency across others 
   Measurement & Visibility  
  Contribute to reporting on strategy performance (e.g., content effectiveness, email and communication metrics, and pipeline influence), supporting the team's ability to demonstrate and communicate impact 
 Use data and analytical reasoning to identify gaps and flag recommendations, contributing to improvement roadmaps and the ongoing health of the recruitment ecosystem 
 Partner with analytics, SEO, and implementation teams to close feedback loops between performance data and strategic decisions 
   Team and Organizational Contribution  
  Support peers and cross-functional collaborators in executing against shared frameworks and practice standards 
 Contribute to cross-functional initiatives, including campaign measurement frameworks and new technology rollouts, as a strategic voice representing student engagement priorities 
 Support knowledge transfer from discovery and strategy into creative and implementation teams, ensuring strategic intent survives the handoff 
   You have:   
 3+ years of experience in marketing strategy, brand strategy, content strategy, engagement communications, or a related field; higher education experience preferred 
 Demonstrated ability to work across multiple practice areas with developing strategic depth in at least one 
 Working understanding of cross-channel lifecycle communications and the student recruitment journey 
 Experience contributing to partner-facing strategy sessions, workshops, or discovery engagements 
 Comfort working in a matrixed environment where influence matters as much as authority 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex ideas clearly to non-technical audiences 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect performance data to strategic decisions 
 English fluency 
   Bonus Points If You Have:   
  Experience in brand strategy, UX, content strategy, sales enablement, or SEO that complements a broad marketing background 
 Familiarity with higher education enrollment tools and CRM or marketing automation platforms 
 Experience contributing to discovery or go-to-market planning, including competitive landscape analysis or program positioning 
 Comfort navigating ambiguity and evolving team structures with a solutions-oriented mindset 
    Role Requirements:
     Location:  Must reside in the continental US, within close proximity to a major airport to facilitate travel to partner universities 
  Internet Connectivity:  Reliable high-speed connection required; quiet workspace for camera-on, partner-facing meetings 
  Core Business Hours:  Available during core hours from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., with some flexibility by time zone 
   Noodle Benefits:   
 Work from our beautiful NYC office OR the comfort of your home office! 
 Computer and charger on us! 
 401(k) with company match, plus equity opportunities 
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family (including mental health benefits like Headspace and Talkspace) 
 Employer-paid life and disability insurance 
 Optional voluntary coverage, including supplemental life, accident, critical illness, and hospital insurance 
 Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), and commuter benefits 
 Pre-tax benefit options that help you save on eligible healthcare, dependent care, and commuting expenses 
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 
 Paid parental leave 
 Wellness initiatives and resources 
 Free subscription to the Calm app 
 Employee discount program 
 4 weeks of paid vacation + 10 paid holidays + paid sick leave 
 Monthly mobile connectivity stipend 
 Annual education stipend for lifelong learning 
 Growth opportunities - we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees can be themselves and grow within and around the company 
   Eligibility Requirements:   
This position is based in the United States, and applicants must be legally authorized to live and work in the United States. Employees are required to reside within the United States for the duration of their employment.

title: Associate Director of Marketing
descriptionText:
About American Heritage Lending   
American Heritage Lending (AHL) is a non-QM mortgage lender headquartered in Irvine, CA. Our roots are in investment property financing — DSCR, fix-and-flip, ground-up construction, bridge, and small-balance multifamily — and we serve the broader non-QM market with a product suite built for borrowers and brokers who don't fit the agency box. We operate across both retail and TPO/wholesale channels.  
We are in the middle of a deliberate transformation from a traditional non-QM lender into a fintech-enabled platform. Technology has become a hockey-stick growth area for us — it now touches nearly every function in the company, from how we price and underwrite loans, to how we train our team, to how we generate and qualify leads, to how brokers and borrowers experience us at every step. That investment is accelerating, not slowing, and it is the single biggest reason our trajectory looks different from the rest of the industry's.  
Marketing sits at the center of that thesis. We are looking for senior marketing leaders to take AHL's marketing function from founder-led to fully built out — and to make the case to the market that AHL is not just another non-QM lender, but a company actively rewriting how non-QM gets originated.      
What you will own    
Demand generation and performance marketing    Run performance marketing end-to-end across paid search, paid social, programmatic, YouTube/CTV, and emerging channels, with a clear weekly cadence on spend, CAC, and ROAS.  Hit CAC and ROAS targets by product and channel across our full non-QM suite — investment property and beyond — managing the team, media buyers, and agency partners delivering against them.  Build and optimize landing pages, lead forms, and digital tools (loan calculators, DSCR estimators, rehab budget tools, and what comes next) across ahlend.com (retail) and ahlendtpo.com (wholesale).    
Content and brand    Define and evolve AHL's brand positioning for distinct audiences: real estate investors and non-QM borrowers on the retail side, and mortgage brokers and TPO partners on the wholesale side.  Run an always-on editorial engine: market-specific content for investors (cap rates, rents, vacancy, absorption), product education across the full non-QM product set, broker enablement, and thought-leadership for senior decision-makers.  Own creative direction across digital, video, social, sales enablement, and event collateral. Maintain and evolve the AHL brand guidelines.    
Lifecycle, CRM, and marketing operations    Run HubSpot day-to-day: workflows, lists, lead scoring, routing, attribution, drip campaigns, and lifecycle automation.  Build and maintain multi-touch attribution that ties marketing spend to funded loan volume — by source, campaign, LO, broker, and product.  Own loyalty and referral programs end-to-end — enrollment, mechanics, comms, and reporting — for both retail borrowers and broker partners.    
SEO and organic growth    Drive organic traffic and qualified leads to AHL's product pages, calculators, and educational content across the full non-QM product set.  Coordinate technical SEO, content SEO, and link acquisition. Own the analytics stack (GA4, Search Console, Google Ads) that ties organic effort to funded volume.    
Partner and channel marketing    Build and run co-marketing programs with real estate investor coaching partners, iBuyers, wholesalers, REI meetups, franchise networks, and the broader ecosystem that drives qualified borrowers to AHL.  Support the TPO/wholesale channel with broker recruitment campaigns, content for AEs to deploy, event presence, and a steady drumbeat of product and rate communications across the full non-QM suite.  Negotiate, structure, and operationalize partner agreements with the BD team — landing pages, tracking, attribution, and unit economics.    
Product marketing in a fintech transformation    Position AHL's accelerating technology investment as a structural competitive advantage. As new tools, data products, and platform capabilities ship — internally and to our customers — translate them into clear value props for brokers, borrowers, and partners.  Make the case that the next decade of non-QM lending will be won by lenders who pair best-in-class capital and credit policy with superior technology — and that AHL is the proof point.  Partner closely with Product and Engineering on launches, naming, positioning, and go-to-market for everything we ship to the outside world.    
Analytics, planning, and operations    Contribute marketing's section of the weekly business review. Report on funded volume by source, CAC, ROAS, broker activations, and campaign-level efficiency.  Help build the annual marketing plan and budget; own the execution detail behind it.  Manage the marketing tech stack: HubSpot, GA4, Google Ads, Meta Business, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Power BI, Looker Studio, and the rest of the kit. Push it forward as our internal tech capability expands.    
Team leadership and management    Lead a team of marketers across one or more functional areas. Hire, develop, and manage direct reports; coach to outcomes; set the performance bar for your group; and contribute to the broader marketing org design alongside the Director.  Develop the people on your team into the next generation of AHL marketing leaders.  Manage agency relationships (paid media, creative, PR) and contractor talent (designers, copywriters, video editors). Hold partners to AHL's standards and replace them when they don't meet the bar.  Partner with Sales, TPO, Operations, Capital Markets, and Technology as a true cross-functional peer.       
What you will bring    
Must-haves    6–9 years of marketing experience with a clear track record of owning programs end-to-end, delivering measurable results, and managing people (direct reports, not just contractors).  Real management experience. You have hired, coached, given hard feedback, and held people accountable. You are ready to do more of it, with more scope.  Proven performance marketing chops. You can talk about specific campaigns you ran, what you spent, what you got back, and what you learned — at the keyword, audience, and creative level.  Fluency with the modern marketing stack: HubSpot (or a peer CRM), Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, GA4, and at least one BI tool (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau).  Comfort with data. You build your own dashboards, you read attribution critically, and you don't outsource the numbers.  Strong writer and editor. You can produce a clean draft of an email, a landing page, or an ad without it needing to be rewritten.  Bias to ship. You move fast, you instrument what you ship, and you iterate against real results.    
Strong preference for    Background in fintech, mortgage, real estate, or B2B/B2B2C financial services.  Experience marketing across multiple product lines and dual audiences (e.g., direct-to-consumer and channel partners).  Familiarity with non-QM, broker / wholesale channel marketing, or other parts of the mortgage value chain (TPO, IMB, correspondent).  Comfort working in a regulated environment; you know what a compliance review is and you don't fear it.  Real fluency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, image and video generators) as production multipliers — and genuine interest in how AI reshapes marketing operations.    
How we will know you are a fit    You are excited about the front-row seat to a fintech transformation in an industry that has earned its reputation for moving slowly.  You ask hard questions about the business model and unit economics, not just the creative brief.  You are skeptical of vanity metrics and direct about what is and isn't working.  You like the idea of an executive partner who is hands-on in marketing rather than abstract about it.  You want to build, not maintain.       
What we offer    Senior leadership role with direct partnership to the Managing Director and a clear seat at the marketing leadership table.  Competitive base salary and performance bonus tied to funded volume and marketing ROI. Clear path to Director-level scope and compensation as the function continues to scale.  Comprehensive health, dental, vision, and 401(k).  Remote arrangement available for the right candidate.  A front-row seat to — and a material role in — the reinvention of non-QM lending. Capital, credit policy, technology, and brand are all on the table. The people who join this team now are the ones who will get to look back in five years and say they helped build it.
